why: Label "Zip Fly (Metal)". Photo shows an unmistakable METAL zipper — individual brass-toned teeth running the length of the fly, drawn half open with the metal pull tab clearly visible, and the waistband laid back to expose the extension tab and its buttonholes. Closure mechanism is the discriminator for this option and metal-vs-button reads instantly, including against the button-fly sibling.
